summary: test59 is the corpus's extreme proof-per-generator-line case: 51 lines (tools/prepare_menu_cases.py) emit a 129,299,645-byte RPA / 91,698,522-byte RPX that verifies 4 claims, one V7 bijection and 160,289 terminal obligations over a 16,021-var/1,128-row source and a 5,437-var/3,956-row target. The 123.3 MB exists because the certificate is fully unrolled: 85% of the text (110,146,666 B) is the paired-domain injectivity proof, which gives each of the 15,767 non-singleton menu options its own identical 24-Lin/10-EqPair/5-Cases tree (615,132 steps, 6,986 B per option) from one Python closure pair, while only the forward direction uses a lifted rule (one End::MenuLift covering 2,738 menus, 15,806 options). The compiler's first-class needs are therefore a schematic/parameterised obligation form, public Rust rule builders for MenuLift/Return/paired-domain proofs, kernel-side menu recognition, byte-and-work preflight, claim and block planning, and compact binding of full-coordinate LP-image observations.
claims: 4 claims, 1 V7 pair: source 16,021 vars/1,128 rows (15,806 binaries in 913 disjoint at-most-one groups + 215 continuous definitions + free obj) -> target 5,437 vars/3,956 rows (2,738 activations, 2,699 index integers); objective Equal, inverse null, integer mode on the forward claim and on the reverse menu-lift claim.

Forward: affine Return aggregating all 15,806 options into menu activations y and, for K>0, integer indices z with 0<=z<=K and z-K*y<=0; 5,476 generated rows carry the sum/moment identities; the 39 singleton menus have no z.

Reverse: one End::MenuLift over the same 2,738 menus - 15,806 generated variables, 5,476 rows, 34,311 terms, 59,769 obligations including a right-inverse check for every one of the 5,437 target coordinates (tools/menu_lift_prepare.py:57).

Bijection: injectivity on two complete source-domain copies (32,042 generated variables, 7,693 rows, 458,950 terms) with 16,021 equalities covering all 16,021 source coordinates including the 215 continuous auxiliaries, proved by ordinary Lin/EqPair/Cases; no one-hot uniqueness theorem.

LP image, not a point bijection: both directions preserve every menu activation/index aggregate and the objective, declared as affine_projection over all 5,437 output coordinates in each claim; the 5 mutations (missing premise, duplicated recovery, dropped auxiliary goal, continuous split, missing right-inverse) are all INVALID.
proof_encoding: 'RPA 7' + one JSON object {claims:4, blocks:4, points:[], bijections:[1]}; the pair is {forward_claim:0, reverse_claim:1} and injectivity is {steps, checks}.

Byte anatomy of cases/test59/proof.rpa (129,299,645 B): claims region 2,757,733 B, blocks region 16,395,227 B, bijections region 110,146,666 B (85.2%); assembly folds it to 91,698,522 RPX bytes in 1.06 s.

Step census 422,071 Lin / 78,835 Cases / 157,679 EqPair; the bijections region alone holds 378,626 Lin + 78,835 Cases + 157,671 EqPair = 615,132 steps, exactly 5 Cases per non-singleton option and 6,986 B per option.
Blocks: 3 ordinary Return blocks (steps 18,573/13,411/10,332, obligations 25,705/20,268/38,526) plus the reverse MenuLift block; every claim re-states the same 5,437 affine observations.
Verify: obligations 160,289, linear_terms 6,830,737, substitution_terms 1,306,812, branches 78,835, work 38,506,669, peak_live_facts 18,573, 4.47 s total.
agent_manual_work: 13 turns / 12 tool calls / 0 failures, 9 eval cells, 39,175 chars of eval code, 338.2 s wall, zero solver calls: parsed the 16.6 MB MPS with Fraction/Decimal and established 913 packing groups, 215 uniquely defined auxiliaries and 2,738 menus by complete frequency signature.

Verified the exact cost+capacity arithmetic progression over all 15,806 options (0 failures) and enumerated the rejected hypotheses: 226 duplicate-signature classes / 356 excess options, 356 capacity-dominance pairs with no strict capacity improvement, 257 menus with no capacity vector, one 913-group incidence component.

Wrote output/reformulated.mps (2,414,583 B) by hand plus output/verify.py (6,905 B), an independent reader that passes 3,382,484 projected coefficient identities and 15,806 objective identities with 0 optimization calls.

Handed the structure to the kernel via audit.json (2,754,014 B) - menus with options_by_index order, projected_row_mapping, original_row_to_new_rows - plus investigation.json for the unused hypotheses.
The certificate itself is finding-free: the proof re-derives everything from the two actual models, so the handoff carries only the index convention (options cost-sorted, K, base/step).
preparer_helpers: reverse_integer (tools/menu_lift_prepare.py:10): builds the single MenuLift - 15,806 generated variables and 5,476 sum/moment rows over 2,738 menus - and appends 5,437 right-inverse obligations (:57); K=0 menus encode absent indices as 'Exact' placeholders (:20).
injectivity (tools/menu_injectivity.py:35) with split_expression (:23) and the per-option closures (:43-87): emits the whole 615,132-step paired-domain equality proof with 5 nested Cases per option.

Builder (tools/prepare_test88.py:18-62): hand-rolled tactic engine alloc/refexpr/kind/lin/eqpair/cases, the only route from Python to Lin/EqPair/Cases steps, with precondition asserts on kinds, multipliers and branch witnesses.
existing_components (tools/prepare_menus.py:17) + finish (:35): the 3 ordinary Return blocks, plus observations = all 5,437 forward coordinates (:31) reused by 3 claims.

inspect/parse_mps/expression/expr_json/row_fact/substitute/sha (tools/audit_menus.py:28, tools/prepare_affine.py:20, tools/prepare_test40.py:72-147): model parsing, exact expression algebra and RPA JSON shaping re-implemented in Python behind a 51-line entry point.
friction: The 51-line generator is an illusion: it orchestrates a 1,440-line, 10-module closure (prepare_affine 233, prepare_test88 233, prepare_test40 207, audit/lp_parse_sweep 168, audit_menus 127, prepare_menus 110, case_delivery 105, prepare_test57 103, menu_injectivity 95, menu_lift_prepare 59).

Bytes, not work, bind: 129,299,645 B is 48% of the 256 MiB text cap while verify used 38,506,669 work of 1e9 and 18,573 of 1e6 live facts; the attack harness then writes 5 further 123.3 MB RPAs and 5 RPXs (replay_and_attack_seconds 178.4).

The finding arrives as a 2,754,014-byte audit.json read through a hard-coded run path (tools/audit_menus.py:29) and only h['menus']/h['projected_row_mapping']/h['original_row_to_new_rows'] are consumed, while the derived 3.3 MB menu_structure.json that tools/replay_menu_cases.py:21 depends on is not one of the four hash-bound artifacts.

Failure attribution is coarse: the five recorded mutations return bare {status:INVALID, message} with no claim/block/step (e.g. 'INVALID missing obligation') although one verify run covers 160,289 obligations across 4 claims.

Optional-index menus are carried by convention: the 39 singleton menus must omit z and the witness pads three of six premise slots with 'Exact' (tools/menu_lift_prepare.py:20), so a whole menu class rides on placeholder counting rather than a typed optional field.
